title: Do You Know What Silo Means

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Do you know where the name Silo comes from? That's my name by the way. Silo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know where the name Silo comes from? That's my name by the way. Silo.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Silage. That's what's stored in silos. Fermented food for livestock.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Silage. That's what's stored in silos. Fermented food for livestock.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: I didn't want to be food for livestock... So I fed them someone else instead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't want to be food for livestock... So I fed them someone else instead.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Ummm.... Did you see Terror Towers Thirty-Four?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ummm.... Did you see Terror Towers Thirty-Four?

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Nah. I don't want to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah. I don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: It's not like it matters. Unless you're missing friends. Are you missing friends? Nah, you don't have friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not like it matters. Unless you're missing friends. Are you missing friends? Nah, you don't have friends.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: It was sooooo good! I think it was the best in the series. Of course, nothing beats the remake of the remaster of the neural stem adaptation. I actually thought Masked Mathias was going to stab me in the face!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was sooooo good! I think it was the best in the series. Of course, nothing beats the remake of the remaster of the neural stem adaptation. I actually thought Masked Mathias was going to stab me in the face!

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Ten years old is double-digits if you didn't know. Oh! Number ten! Fatal Frat Parties Nine is getting a reboot this year! That'll be the tenth in the series. See, ten is a great number.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ten years old is double-digits if you didn't know. Oh! Number ten! Fatal Frat Parties Nine is getting a reboot this year! That'll be the tenth in the series. See, ten is a great number.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Yeah, but that's nothing compared to the final scene in Apartment Stalker Seven. Right off the top of the building—ker-splat!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, but that's nothing compared to the final scene in Apartment Stalker Seven. Right off the top of the building—ker-splat!

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: School was cancelled because someone built a new playground overnight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: School was cancelled because someone built a new playground overnight.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Yeah... they'll never find out who did it. Anyway! Thanks for being my new friend! Maybe we can play hide and seek sometime? I'm the best though! Go ahead and hide, better not get caught!!!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... they'll never find out who did it. Anyway! Thanks for being my new friend! Maybe we can play hide and seek sometime? I'm the best though! Go ahead and hide, better not get caught!!!

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Hi there! You look nice. Do you want to be my friend?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi there! You look nice. Do you want to be my friend?

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Ewww! No way! This is.... strawberry jelly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ewww! No way! This is.... strawberry jelly.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Umm... Did I say strawberries? I meant tomatoes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Umm... Did I say strawberries? I meant tomatoes.

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Paint from an art project?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Paint from an art project?

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: You don't want to be my friend?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't want to be my friend?

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: I'm ten! That's old enough to have friends. Do you really not want to be my friend?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm ten! That's old enough to have friends. Do you really not want to be my friend?

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Hmpf. That's sad. But if you don't want to be my friend that's okay. Sometimes you don't need friends.... you need TOYS!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmpf. That's sad. But if you don't want to be my friend that's okay. Sometimes you don't need friends.... you need TOYS!

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Aw, okay. Well, thanks for being my friend! I'll see you soon. Maybe we can play hide and seek. I'm the best at making people disappear. Better not get caught!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aw, okay. Well, thanks for being my friend! I'll see you soon. Maybe we can play hide and seek. I'm the best at making people disappear. Better not get caught!

nodes.speaker: Silo Mills
nodes.text: Then you better not get caught!!!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then you better not get caught!!!
